map.以访问 www.example.com 为例，DNS 解析的完整过程：: Taking www.example.com as an example, the complete DNS resolution process:
map.浏览器首先检查本地 DNS 缓存（通常 1-60 分钟 TTL）: The browser first checks its local DNS cache (typically 1-60 minutes TTL)
map.查询 OS 的 DNS 缓存（如 Windows DNS Client 服务）: Query the OS DNS cache (e.g. the Windows DNS Client service)
map.查询配置的本地 DNS 服务器（如 8.8.8.8、114.114.114.11: Query the configured local DNS server (e.g. 8.8.8.8, 114.114.114.114)
map.递归解析器询问根服务器（.），获取 .com TLD 服务器地址: The recursive resolver queries the root server (.), obtaining the .com TLD server address
map.询问 .com TLD 服务器，获取 example.com 的权威服务器: Query the .com TLD server to obtain the authoritative server for example.com
map.询问 example.com 的权威服务器，获取 www.example.com: Query example.com's authoritative server to obtain the A record for www.example.com
map.递归解析器将结果返回浏览器，并缓存记录（按 TTL）: The recursive resolver returns the result to the browser and caches the record (per TTL)
map.整个流程通常在 10-100 毫秒内完成。CDN 通常利用 DNS 解析实现就近: The entire process usually completes within 10-100 ms. CDNs typically use DNS resolution for nearby access (e.g. Edge DNS, Route 53).
